dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Won't you be lonely here all by yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Trow
dialogues.text: Sometimes, many people come here, and the place is incredibly crowded. At other times, it is just like it is now, empty as can be.

dialogues.speaker: Trow
dialogues.text: Reminds you of the tides lapping against the shore, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Trow
dialogues.text: And with these tides for company, I'm not lonesome at all.
